name: Suzuki SV650 / SV650S (2003-2016)
intro: The second SV650. Fuel injected and easy to live with. Some California bikes had a fuel tank recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. California-spec 2003-2005 SV650s and some 2006 bikes are in recall 06V013 for a fuel tank that can crack at a bracket weld.
A-002.reason: A cracked tank can leak fuel. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Fuel tank can crack at the vapor separator bracket weld and leak.
